skills.title: Material and surface authenticity

skills.title: Visual failure diagnosis and corrective prompting
skills.summary: Identify a single dominant defect, attribute likely prompt/reference/engine cause with uncertainty, adjust smallest effective constraint, and retest without changing unrelated variables.
